subject: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan
messages:
From: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: security@finsecure.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan

Hi Alison / FinSecure security team,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, we want to make the production SSO+SCIM cutover predictable while keeping your conditional access posture intact. Attached is a first-draft playbook and a SCIM field mapping that our implementation engineers will follow. High-level asks: 

- Confirm the list of IP allowlist ranges you require for the initial rollout (we can add region-based routing later).
- Approve the two service-account profiles below (read-only user provisioning + provisioning with group-mgmt).
- Identify any conditional-access exemptions for the redwood-service accounts (if your org requires exception rules, we need the exact policy IDs).

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 6/30: Align on exceptions and mapping (this thread)
- Fri 7/2: Test SCIM provisioning in staging (00:00–04:00 UTC maintenance window)
- Tue 7/6: Prod cutover with live monitoring and fallback to API keys for 1 hour

Attachments: redwood_svc-account-playbook.md (playbook), scim_field_mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping).

Next step: can you confirm the policy IDs and preferred maintenance window? If easier, we can hop on a short 20-min call today.

Thanks,
Kar
KarThik Iyer
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

From: Alison Park <alison.park@finsecure.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finsecure.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan

Kar,

Thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts. Quick answers from our side: 

- IP ranges: 34.210.0.0/16, 18.197.0.0/16. We will add them to a temporary allowlist for the staging and prod maintenance windows.
- Policy IDs: we use ConditionalPolicy: CP-2134 (MFA enforced) and CP-2199 (Device compliance). We cannot broadly exempt user MFA; any exception must be scoped to service accounts with matching AppIDs.
- Service account AppIDs: please provide the AppIDs you plan to use (we need them to scope exceptions).

We can support a staging run on Fri 7/2 from 00:00–04:00 UTC. For prod, request 07:00–09:00 UTC on Tue 7/6 to coincide with our on-call shift.

Also: can you confirm how you'll signal a rollback? Will you revoke SCIM provisioning and restore prior groups, or do you prefer us to disable the Redwood app from our SAML apps list?

Best,
Alison Park
Director, Security Operations | FinSecure
alison.park@finsecure.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@finsecure.com>
Cc: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan

Alison — really appreciate the quick turnaround. A few details to make scope explicit: 

1) Service-account AppIDs: 
- svc-redwood-provisioner (appId: RED-PROV-001) — used for SCIM write operations (create/update membership).
- svc-redwood-telemetry (appId: RED-TEL-002) — used for health checks, metrics push (read-only for user objects).

We will generate short-lived tokens for both AppIDs and rotate them on every deployment. For the exceptions, our recommendation is: apply the CP-2134/CP-2199 exemptions only to AppIDs RED-PROV-001 and RED-TEL-002 and only for the two maintenance windows. This keeps end-user MFA intact.

2) Rollback signal: the primary rollback will be initiated from Redwood via a single signed webhook to your SRE runbook URL (we included the webhook format in the playbook). If you prefer, disabling the Redwood SAML app on your side will also be an immediate kill-switch. We'll treat both as valid rollback actions and include monitoring alerts to escalate.

3) SCIM mapping: attached is a small delta to the mapping that ensures group membership sync uses externalId as the source-of-truth. Please confirm the schema in the second tab.

Action items for FinSecure: send confirmation of policy scoping (CP IDs + AppIDs) and confirm prod maintenance window 07:00–09:00 UTC Tue 7/6.

Laura Bennett
Senior Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 10:01 AM Alison Park <alison.park@finsecure.com> wrote:
> Kar,
>
> Thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts...

From: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan

Thanks — we received the policy IDs and confirmation on windows. A couple of updates after engineering review: 

- Small change to prod window: we'll start cutover at 07:30 UTC and hold for 60 minutes of elevated monitoring before switching traffic. That gives FinSecure SRE time to validate logs before the full commit.
- Playbook update: added the exact webhook payload we will send for rollback (see section 4.3 of redwood_svc-account-playbook.md).
- Implementation owner: Monica Patel will run the staging provisioning and smoke tests on Fri. Laura will lead prod cutover. 

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/D-9342 — I've updated the milestone to "SCIM staging scheduled".

If you confirm the 07:30 UTC start and that your SREs will watch logs for the first 60 minutes, Monica will initiate the staging run on Fri.

Cheers,
Kar

From: Alison Park <alison.park@finsecure.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finsecure.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional Access Exceptions & Service-account orchestration plan

Kar, Laura, Monica — confirmed.

- Prod start 07:30 UTC Tue 7/6, FinSecure SRE on-call will monitor for 60 minutes and has alert hooks ready.
- We will create scoped exceptions for RED-PROV-001 and RED-TEL-002 against CP-2134 and CP-2199 for the maintenance windows only.
- We received the playbook; we'll validate the webhook signature profile and respond if anything blocks.

Looking forward to the staging run on Fri. Send the final checklist when ready.

Best,
Alison
